description: This Java class defines a custom Android UI component 'BackgroundContainer' which extends FrameLayout. It manages drawing a shadowed background drawable over a specified area, with methods to show and hide the background.

classes.name: BackgroundContainer
classes.description: A custom Android widget extending FrameLayout that overlays a shadowed background drawable over a specified area.

methods.name: BackgroundContainer
methods.description: Constructors for Creating instances of BackgroundContainer with different initialization parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the background drawable from resources.

methods.name: showBackground
methods.description: Sets up the contract for displaying the background overlay from a specified top to bottom area.

methods.name: hideBackground
methods.description: Hides the background overlay and stops drawing it.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the FrameLayout's onDraw method to render the background drawable if 'showing' is true.
